description.en:
Puts the active camera at one of five fixed views of the pitch, for scenes played during a match. It starts camera control on the active camera (CamCtrlInit) and places it with CamCtrlSetPosRef.
The views are given by the constants of ie4_ev_main.nut: CAMERA_CENTER (0), CAMERA_MY_GOAL (1), CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL (2), CAMERA_MY_BENCH (3), CAMERA_OTHER_BENCH (4). The goal and bench views of the two sides mirror each other along the Z axis.
With _waza_scale true, each coordinate goes through ToScaleWazaMap, for the scaled map used by Special Move scenes. Any other view number leaves the camera where it is (camera control is still started).
View: CAMERA_CENTER (0), CAMERA_MY_GOAL (1), CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL (2), CAMERA_MY_BENCH (3) or CAMERA_OTHER_BENCH (4).
true to scale the coordinates with ToScaleWazaMap.
